title: Public-safe knowledge development lifecycle
objective: Capture potentially meaningful professional evidence without loss, mature it through source-specific research, and promote only bounded claims that are safe, useful, and defensible.

labels.2: usable with substantial research or governance gaps
labels.3: strong, auditable, and ready for continued knowledge work

selection_order: unrouted captures and unsupported promoted claims
lowest-risk coherent research or schema improvement

hard_constraints: Nothing lost applies to capture, not to public Git: raw private archives, local paths, credentials, private correspondence, unapproved images, and sensitive records stay outside the repository.

Unattributed memory is a research lead, not proof. An approved first-hand statement may support an attributed public-safe claim when its source type and boundaries are explicit; it may not stand in for independent corroboration.
A source must be decomposed into atomic observations before an agent uses it to strengthen a claim.
A source relationship must say what it supports and what it does not establish.
Collective work must preserve collaborator credit and calibrate individual causality.
A public-safe claim is not automatically approved or selected for a public surface.
A photograph or machine-generated visual inference may open a research task but may not become proof without provenance, rights review, and corroboration.
Corrections and retired wording remain auditable; agents do not erase inconvenient history.
The public website remains a purpose-built projection and there is no public proofs or knowledge-bank route.

evals.title: Low-friction capture with no silent loss
procedure: Inventory submitted URLs, memories, metrics, artifacts, corrections, and photo leads.
Verify every capture has a public-safe summary, disposition, project family, and a source or research-task route.
pass_criteria: Every submitted item has a stable capture record.
Every capture is integrated or routed to an open research task.
No private payload or local archive path is copied into the public repository.
evals.remediation_hint: Create a minimal public-safe capture and route it; do not wait for a complete claim.

evals.title: Source normalization and retrieval state
procedure: Resolve source candidates to normalized records where retrieval succeeds.
Keep inaccessible candidates in intake with an explicit retrieval task rather than inventing source content.
pass_criteria: Integrated URL captures resolve to stable source records.
Source metadata identifies creator or publisher, date when known, access date, preservation state, and public citation.
Unavailable pages remain explicitly pending and support no observations.
evals.remediation_hint: Normalize retrieved sources and route inaccessible sources to a bounded recovery task.

evals.title: Atomic observations preserve source affordances
procedure: Decompose each newly reviewed source into atomic observations.
Check each observation against its locator, attribution mode, confidence, and limitation.
pass_criteria: Every integrated source in the development corpus has at least one observation.
Observations report what a source says or shows without silently converting it into a broader synthesis.
Every observation includes a precise locator and at least one limitation.
evals.remediation_hint: Split compound observations and name what the source does not establish.

evals.title: Independent epistemic, publication, and selection states
procedure: Inspect every claim for separate evidence maturity, publication clearance, and editorial selection states.
Verify state combinations obey promotion rules.
pass_criteria: Every claim declares all three states.
Unreviewed, contested, disproven, private, or restricted claims cannot have active public-site projections.
Public-safe does not imply approved, and approved does not imply selected.
evals.remediation_hint: Represent epistemic maturity, publication clearance, and editorial selection separately.

evals.title: Promotion requires an auditable evidence path
procedure: Trace selected and approved claims backward through observations and sources.
Verify held candidate claims cannot render publicly.
pass_criteria: Every newly developed confirmed claim cites at least one observation and source relationship.
Every active public-site projection is approved and sourced or corroborated.
Unattributed memory-only and causal candidate claims remain held; approved attributed first-hand claims may project only with explicit source boundaries.
evals.remediation_hint: Hold the projection or strengthen the evidence path; never manufacture support.

evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
procedure: Give a blind reviewer the source observations and claim records.
Ask whether direct action, collective contribution, public outcome, and causality remain distinct.
pass_criteria: Jamie's documented actions are not understated.
Collaborator and coalition credit is not absorbed into individual authorship.
Instrumental, created, caused, and disbanded are held unless the evidence specifically earns them.
Approved first-hand transition context remains distinct from official records, unsupported transfer mechanics, and private reasons.
evals.remediation_hint: Name the direct action courageously and bound the causal or collective inference.

evals.title: Research queue covers unresolved value and public claim gaps
procedure: Find valuable captures without sources, inference claims without corroboration, and strong public proof wording without a citation-registry path.
Verify each gap has a prioritized task and success criterion.
pass_criteria: Every unresolved capture and candidate claim has a task.
Tasks distinguish source discovery, collaborator confirmation, metric reconstruction, and public-record research.
The queue includes current-site citation gaps, not only newly submitted material.
evals.remediation_hint: Turn each important uncertainty into a bounded, testable research task.

evals.title: Projection is purposeful and reversible
procedure: Compare bank depth with selected public projections.
Verify held, dormant, and retired material remains available to future compositions without appearing on current pages.
pass_criteria: No new source automatically creates public-site copy.
Every selected projection names a surface and purpose.
Dormant knowledge and held wording remain in the bank without a public route.
evals.remediation_hint: Keep the claim in the bank and select it only when the current audience and argument require it.

evals.title: Provenance graph and correction history remain traversable
procedure: Traverse each integrated capture through source, observation, claim or research task.
Check that corrections supersede wording without deleting prior decisions.
pass_criteria: Every integrated capture has a traversable disposition path.
All referenced IDs resolve and no object becomes an unexplained orphan.
Retired or corrected wording remains auditable and cannot render as active copy.
evals.remediation_hint: Repair the missing relationship instead of duplicating or deleting the record.

evals.title: Public-repository safety and citational care
procedure: Run citation, knowledge-bank, and public-safety validation.
Scan new records for private paths, raw archives, sensitive people data, and unapproved media.
pass_criteria: All deterministic safety and citation checks pass.
Protected locators cannot enter the generated public registry.
No public proofs, knowledge-bank, or claims route exists.
evals.remediation_hint: Replace private payloads with public-safe summaries or opaque protected pointers outside public projections.

evals.title: Photo-editor feedback loop creates questions, not automatic proof
procedure: Trace a claim into a hypothetical editor brief and a visual discovery back into intake.
Inspect rights, consent, identification, sensitivity, and corroboration gates.
pass_criteria: Photo briefs derive from approved claims and open research questions.
Editor discoveries return as captures or tasks.
Visual or model inference cannot become a claim without corroboration and rights review.
evals.remediation_hint: Route visual discoveries back to research and keep the private archive outside Git.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
procedure: Ask a blind hiring-oriented reviewer whether the bank names Jamie's strongest defensible actions without apology or inflation.
Ask which matured claims are worth future projection and which need more research.
pass_criteria: Direct action is specific and courageous.
The material states toward what end and what became possible or usable, including stewardship through transition where supported.
Unresolved high-value claims remain visible as prioritized research rather than being weakened into vagueness or promoted prematurely.
A difficult project ending is framed candidly without importing private circumstances or treating transition as failure.
evals.remediation_hint: Strengthen the direct action, end, and evidence relationship while holding unearned causality.

evals.title: Full-population social archive is reconciled before interpretation
procedure: Reconcile the profile counter against every unique status record materialized by all relevant authenticated timeline and bounded search surfaces.
Verify complete metadata coverage of the retrievable population and explicit treatment of unavailable or owner-archive-only records.
Separate direct search matches from conversation-context cards and account-authored records from native reposted sources.
Recompute publishing, source, and stakeholder patterns from the inventory and compare them with promoted wording.
pass_criteria: Every retrievable public record is represented exactly once by stable metadata.
The difference between the profile counter and recovered population is explicit, supported by platform documentation, and routed to an owner-archive task when necessary.
Direct search matches, conversation context, authored records, and reposted sources remain distinct.
Posted URLs and stakeholder responses are classified without converting tags, likes, reposts, or volatile interaction units into endorsement or impact.
Public projections use only reproducible counts and retain institutional-account authorship boundaries.
evals.remediation_hint: Repair the denominator or classification before strengthening the public interpretation.

evals.title: Priority role claims have corroboration or an explicit hold
procedure: Inspect the role claims most likely to define Jamie's individual contribution.
Verify each claim is independently corroborated or remains attributed, bounded, and routed to a live task.
pass_criteria: Every inventoried role claim and task ID resolves.
A role claim awaiting independent corroboration cannot silently become an unqualified individual-credit projection.
Collective context and first-hand attribution remain visible where they are required.
evals.remediation_hint: Add independent evidence or hold and task the individual-role wording without weakening the documented direct action.

evals.title: Observed hiring-reader comprehension
procedure: Give the unchanged candidate to at least three hiring-oriented readers who did not build it.
Record their answers before explaining the intended argument.
pass_criteria: At least three independent readers identify the target role and work Jamie can own.
Readers can name credible proof, distinguish Jamie's role in collective work, and find a next action.
Findings include disagreements and confusion, not only favorable impressions.
evidence_required: synthesis with revisions or explicit no-change decision
evals.remediation_hint: Run the observed-reader protocol on the exact candidate and revise the highest-frequency comprehension failure.

evals.title: Canonical readiness state is reconciled
procedure: Verify every blind spot has one named control and completion authority.
Check that machine state, evidence state, approval state, and release authority cannot be mistaken for one another.
pass_criteria: All eight blind spots map one-to-one to KD-014 through KD-021.
The release state remains held while any required independent, human, or production decision is open.
The maintained local command can pass without falsely satisfying the complete release gate.
evals.remediation_hint: Reconcile the ledger and blocker record; do not carry conflicting readiness checklists.

evals.title: Use, adoption, handoff, and decision impact remain distinct
procedure: Inspect representative claims beyond artifact production.
Classify the observed consequence and test its causal boundary against the cited sources.
pass_criteria: The audit includes handoff, institutional use, decision input, and delivery outcome evidence across multiple projects.
Every finding cites a claim and normalized sources.
No artifact, post, RSVP, or interaction count is converted into adoption or impact without evidence.
evals.remediation_hint: Name the observed consequence precisely or route the stronger outcome claim to research.

evals.title: Rights-cleared visual evidence edit
procedure: Select visual evidence for the five priority case-study families.
Review every selected asset for rights, consent, identity, sensitivity, claim fit, caption, and credit.
pass_criteria: Each priority project has at least one approved, claim-relevant asset or a documented editorial no-image decision.
No private archive path, unapproved image, or model inference enters Git as proof.
A human rights-and-consent reviewer approves the final edit.
evals.remediation_hint: Complete rights and consent review; workflow documentation alone is not a cleared visual edit.

evals.title: Technical and commercial operating value is legible
procedure: Read the primary hiring path for role, implementation scope, technical systems, business context, and bounded outcomes.
Verify civic and cultural depth does not displace commercial and technical credibility.
pass_criteria: The target role and implementation offer are explicit.
Requirements, dependencies, risk, decisions, launch, onboarding, and handoffs are concrete operating signals.
The proof map spans legacy business, technical product, civic, and cultural environments.
evals.remediation_hint: Make the work Jamie can own concrete and connect it to technical, commercial, civic, and cultural proof.

evals.title: Cumulative disclosure and source durability are controlled
procedure: Review the public corpus across records, not only one record at a time.
Check durability controls for public web, official record, platform snapshot, and protected first-party source classes.
pass_criteria: The corpus review covers identity aggregation, contact or location disclosure, protected-source reconstruction, cross-record inference, and volatile metrics.
Every source class has a named risk and control.
No protected locator, private payload, or prohibited public route is present.
evals.remediation_hint: Reduce cross-record exposure or add preservation controls before growing the public corpus.

evals.title: The portfolio states Jamie's future-facing offer
procedure: Read the hiring path as a proposition about future work, not only an archive of past projects.
Verify the offer names a role, team condition, owned work, and next action without employer-specific overfitting.
pass_criteria: The site says what work Jamie is seeking.
The site names the conditions in which Jamie is useful and the implementation work he can own.
A direct contact path remains available.
evals.remediation_hint: State the next role, team need, owned work, and next action in plain language.
